The '''Ahakistan rebels''' were a resistance movement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ahakista/Legends|Ahakista]]. The rebels grew tired of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Ahakistan Council|government]], and attempted to overthrow them under their leader, [[Dunlan]], leading to a [[Ahakistan civil war|civil war]]. However, one of Dunlan's trusted lieutenants, [[Astor]], betrayed the movement, and provided [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] with the location of one of their safehouses. Shortly thereafter, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under Vader's command attacked, killing most of the rebels there, but failing to eliminate Dunlan, who was present. Dunlan, though, was later tracked down and killed by Vader.
